selected_approach: Add optional normalized tags, escaped title/content search, AND tag filtering, allowlisted sorting, bounded pagination, and tag usage counts.

Add tag summary before parameter route

compatibility_considerations: Preserve tags when legacy updates omit them
risks: Regex scans do not scale to large collections
